import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
income_edu = income_edu.sort_values('mean', ascending=False)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(range(len(income_edu)), income_edu['mean'], 
                       yerr=income_edu['std'], capsize=5, 
                       color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(income_edu)))
axes[0, 0].set_xticks(range(len(income_edu)))
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(income_edu.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Average Income ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Average Income by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars1, income_edu['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 500,
                   f'n={count}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']

# Create a donut chart for spending distribution
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(spending_means, labels=spending_labels, 
                                          autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                          colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(spending_cols)))
centre_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), 0.70, fc='white')
axes[0, 1].add_artist(centre_circle)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Distribution of Customer Spending by Category', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Make autotexts white and bold
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_means = df[purchase_cols].mean()
purchase_labels = ['Web Purchases', 'Catalog Purchases', 'Store Purchases']

x_pos = np.arange(len(purchase_labels))
bars3 = axes[1, 0].bar(x_pos, purchase_means, 
                       color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(purchase_labels)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(purchase_labels, rotation=0)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, value in zip(bars3, purchase_means):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
                   f'{value:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11)

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
# Calculate age from Year_Birth
current_year = 2024
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Create age groups
age_bins = [18, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 100]
age_labels = ['18-29', '30-39', '40-49', '50-59', '60-69', '70+']
df['Age_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, right=False)

# Create income groups
income_bins = [0, 30000, 50000, 70000, 90000, 200000]
income_labels = ['<30k', '30-50k', '50-70k', '70-90k', '>90k']
df['Income_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Income'], bins=income_bins, labels=income_labels, right=False)

# Create cross-tabulation
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df['Age_Group'], df['Income_Group'], normalize='index') * 100

# Plot heatmap
sns.heatmap(cross_tab, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage (%)'}, ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Income Group ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Customer Distribution: Age vs Income Groups', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics and Spending Behavior', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
